rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of ExportDeclaration statements in max-statements-per-line rule
rawFindings.explanation: The regular expression SINGLE_CHILD_ALLOWED was changed to remove ExportDefaultDeclaration and ExportNamedDeclaration from allowed single child node types. This causes the rule to count every export statement separately, potentially reporting more statements than appropriate on a line containing export declarations. The previous expression allowed skipping counting of non-block exports similarly to control statements, but the new regex excludes export declarations, leading to change in counting
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore ExportDefaultDeclaration and ExportNamedDeclaration in the SINGLE_CHILD_ALLOWED regex to maintain correct skipping behavior for export declarations.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Lines containing export declarations like 'export default foo = 0;' are now counted as multiple statements leading to erroneous 'too many statements' errors, where previously they were counted as one statement per line.
